title: ArgOS decision record
description: One record per decision, one JSON object per line of the decision log (ARCHITECTURE contract 7, STATE_ESTIMATION clock rules). Every screen line, the event log, the replay check and the sentence read this record. Times are ship time in seconds (tick n is n s). Wall-clock time and latency_ms live only in the timing log, keyed by seq, so a replay reproduces every record byte for byte. Fields are optional unless the record's kind and verdict require them (allOf below).

seq.description: Decision and record counter; every command a decision sends carries it

tick.description: The tick of the snapshot the decision ran on

t_s.description: Ship time of that snapshot (t_ship_s, equal to tick)

applies_at_tick.description: Tick whose frame applies this decision's commands: always tick + 1

kind.description: D1 admission, D2 placement, D3 right of way, D4 shedding and restore, D5 crew policy, safety: a stop, hold or secure answered in 200 ms

subject.description: What was decided, for example 'G4 onto G1, G2, G3' or 'G6.unit'

mission.description: Id of the priority file in force

verdict.description: D1: yes, yes-if, no, not-now, card-rejected. D2: placed, unplaced. D3: proceeds. D4: hold, shed, unconfirmed. D5: held, cleared, not-now, automatic, forbidden, confirm, standing_plan. D4 also restore. safety: sent, not_needed, cannot

ceiling_ms.description: The A.8 compute ceiling this decision is held to (30000 D1 and D2, 2000 D3, 5000 D4, 200 safety). A fixed number, not a measurement: the measured latency_ms is in the timing log

timed_out.description: The watchdog cut the decision off at its ceiling; replay applies the logged outcome

binding.description: The line that bound: the most over, or for a yes the tightest ship-wide line. For D4, the class that sets the shed limit (capacity is that class's capacity now; limit_kw is capacity minus headroom)

also_failing.description: Every other line over its limit

card_alone.description: NO: the binding class with every installed guest removed, which still fails

options.description: YES-IF: the minimal removal sets, ranked (index 0 is the recommendation)

genset.description: D1: the one-genset-down check (DEC-35) for the set as given

seawater_tip_c.description: Seawater temperature at which cooling stops holding this set; null when it holds across the scan or the set cannot be placed

next_window.description: NOT NOW: when the decision can be yes

field.description: CARD REJECTED: the loader's problem, naming the field ('placement.parts[1].mass_t: -1 is less than the minimum of 0')

kept_previous.description: CARD REJECTED: true when the previously loaded card stays in force

override.description: DEC-32: a captain forced a refused admission; the binding line stays in the record

placement.description: Every part's position, 'G3.cradle': 'bay1'; null when a part has no position as given

placement_rejected.description: D2: the positions considered and refused for the subject's parts, with why

yields.description: D3: the guest that gives way

deadline_t_s.description: D3, D5: the ship time the hard limit sets (G4's land-by)

leg_ends_t_s.description: D3: when the loser's current activity would end if left alone

wait_for_leg_end.description: D3: whether the winner could wait for leg_ends_t_s and still meet deadline_t_s

conflicts.description: D3: each ship-state signal both sides need differently, with what each needs, and any card exclusion

reserved.description: kW held for a guest ahead of its draw, keyed by guest

load_kw.description: D4: committed load before any step

limit_kw.description: D4: the shed limit, min(power, cooling) minus headroom

load_after_kw.description: D4: load after the steps taken

steps.description: D4: steps taken, in order; D5 may list none

armed.description: D4: the next steps of the ladder, ready, in order

order_source.description: Whether the priority file's shed_order (declared) or the computed price set the ladder

losses.description: What every guest aboard keeps, keyed by guest; a guest that loses nothing has equal before and after

trigger.description: The confirmed fault or event that started the decision, for example genset_trip or cooling_degraded

injected.description: The trigger was an injected event; the screen labels it INJECTED

raw_event_t_s.description: Fault-driven decisions: the first tick one of the fault's own signals was true

confirmed_t_s.description: Fault-driven decisions: the tick the fault met its confirmation rule

first_shed_due_t_s.description: D4: raw_event_t_s + 5, the A.8 deadline for the first shed command to apply

unconfirmed_because.description: D4 unconfirmed: why nothing was shed (feed stale, fault held while its votes are stale)

rule.description: D5: the crew rule, for example R3

crew_aboard.description: D5: crew level the decision ran at

crew_policy.description: D5: who decides at this crew level, from the priority file's confirm or rules.r3.confirm

approach_min.description: D5: G4's approach time before landing (rules.r3.approach_min)

evidence.description: D5: the signals that decided hold, latch or refusal, with their values

deck_evidence.description: D5: the evidence in words, as the core states it ('no answer from the bridge'); the sentence prefers evidence when both are present

request.description: D5: a crew or guest request the rule answered

inputs_hash.description: First 16 hex of sha256 over what the decision read (cards, priority file, snapshot), canonical JSON

sentence.description: The one or two sentences built from this record's fields by src/sdv/explain.py; a D4 hold adds a third for its armed ladder and the envelope case

queued.description: D4: 60 S steps still needed, each taken on a later tick after a fresh reading, by its due tick

responses.description: D4: each guest's response class under the active profile (200 MS, 5 S, 60 S; A.8, DEC-60)

kw.description: Its committed draw now: the larger of its mode, a reservation and a fresh reading

activity.description: What the guest reports doing, from the snapshot (holding_depth, airborne, transmitting)

envelope_mode.description: The mode of its envelope draw (ledger.envelope_mode)

envelope_kw.description: Its envelope draw, the sustained worst case admission judged it at (A.1, ledger.envelope_kw)

envelope.description: D4: each guest now against its envelope draw, keyed by guest; a hold's sentence says why the envelope set, every guest at its envelope draw, does not arise (R-067)

full_sequence_due_t_s.description: raw_event_t_s + 60 s (A.8), ship time: every step applied by this tick

healthy_since_t_s.description: restore: ship time since every fault read healthy

line.description: One ledger line as the decision saw it (contract 8)

class.description: mass, stability, power, heat, line_port, line_stbd, satcom, los_radio, backbone, compute, mast_mass, mast_area, mast_air_cooling, flight_deck_drone, placement, at_sea_lift, r3_lead, ...

free.description: capacity minus demand; negative when over

unit.description: t, t_eq, kW, kg, m2, Mbit/s, cores, halves, min

degraded_by.description: Causes that cut the capacity, 'cause: detail'

step.description: One ladder step: a throttle, or a shed when to_mode is off

from_kw.description: The guest's draw before the step

to_kw.description: The guest's draw after the step

load_after_kw.description: Total load once this step and those before it are taken

cost_per_kw.description: Mission weight x capability lost / kW freed

capability_lost_pct.description: Share of the guest's capability this step takes, in %

value_lost.description: Mission value lost: weight x capability lost

response.description: The step's response class: 5 S first action, 60 S full sequence (A.8), or a 30 S restore

due_t_s.description: Ship time by which this step must be applied: first_shed_due_t_s for 5 S, full_sequence_due_t_s for 60 S

reserve_kw.description: Guest reserve with one genset down (the raw line)

gate_kw.description: min(reserve, cooling at 30 C) minus headroom

steps.description: The throttles that make it hold, in ladder order

option.description: One YES-IF condition: remove these guests (and make these moves)

value_lost.description: Sum of the removed guests' mission weights

mission_critical.description: The set removes a mission-critical guest (ranked last)

moves.description: Installed parts that move, to their new position

move_hours.description: Crane time for the moves, low and high

within_days.description: port_call: the longest the ship stays out (A.10)

event.description: event: what must happen first, for example 'G4 secured'

held_by.description: held: the installed part in that position

move_hours.description: held: crane time to move the holder

line.description: The line that position would break or the space it has

hard_limit.description: A card's hard limit that applied, contract 1 shape

reading.description: The signal's value the decision read, for example G4.battery_pct 18

minutes_lost.description: Low and high, in minutes of the loser's activity

open_ended.description: No resume time: minutes_lost is a lower bound

holds.description: Where the loser waits: depth, at_sea

leg_ends_at_min.description: When the paused leg now ends, low and high

capability_before.description: Share of capability kept before, from the card's mode table

capability.description: The card's capability name, for example sar_air

signal.description: A name from config/signals.yaml: hlo_deck_report, deck_latched_clear, last_sweep, deck_activity_since_sweep, standing_plan

t_s.description: Ship time of the reading or report
